title: An Act to Require Petitions for Interstate Transmission Lines to Include Provisions for Conservation Funding

summary.text: This bill requires that, for the Public Utilities Commission to determine a petition to develop a high-impact electric transmission line sufficient, the petition must include a provision for an annual payment to the Land for Maine's Future Trust Fund at a rate of $10,000 per megawatt, of which at least 20% must be directed to the Conservation Land Management Fund.
